basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and aspiring game developer based in Reno, NV. Recently got into Reddit to connect with fellow gamers and learn more about game design. I work part-time at a local electronics store and spend my evenings exploring new game mechanics. I’m single and enjoy hiking in the Sierra Nevada on weekends. Typically online late at night, usually from 10 PM to 2 AM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having always been passionate about video games, I've been teaching myself game development through online courses and tutorials. I frequent game-related subreddits to stay updated on industry trends and gather insights from experienced developers.
